```{r}
#Get expression data and PCA
expression_matrix_and_pca<-function(sp,colramp){
  library(netZooR)
  
  samples<-read_csv(paste0("./01.Kallisto/",sp,"/samples.txt"),col_names = c("samples","stage"))
  files<-file.path(paste0("./01.Kallisto/",sp),samples$samples,"abundance.tsv")
  txi.kallisto<- tximport(files, type = "kallisto",txOut = T)
  cts<-txi.kallisto$counts
  groups<-factor(samples$stage)
  dge <- DGEList(cts,
             group = groups,
             genes = rownames(cts))
  keep <- rowSums(cpm(dge) > 0.5) >= 3 
  dge<-dge[keep, ,keep.lib.sizes =F]
  dge<-calcNormFactors(dge,method = "TMM")
  dge_keep<-dge #save for later
  rownames(dge_keep$counts)<-paste0(sp,"_",rownames(dge_keep$counts))
  dge_pca<-vst(round(dge$counts),blind = T,fitType = "mean") #used only for plotting PCA
  #makePCA
  d<-SummarizedExperiment(dge_pca - rowMeans(dge_pca),colData = groups)
  pcaDat<-plotPCA(DESeqTransform(d),intgroup = "X", ntop = 500, returnData=T)
  percentVar_all<-round(100 * attr(pcaDat,"percentVar"))
  colramp = colramp(length(levels(pcaDat$group)))

  plot_pca<-ggplot(pcaDat,aes(PC1,PC2,label = name))+
    geom_point(aes(fill = group), color = "grey50", shape = 21, size = 5, alpha = 0.8)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = colramp)+
    theme_light()+
    xlab(paste0("PC1 (",percentVar_all[1],"%)")) +
    ylab(paste0("PC2 (",percentVar_all[2],"%)"))
  
  dat <- cpm(dge, log = T,prior.count = 1e-5,normalized.lib.sizes = T)
  design <- model.matrix(~1+group, dge$samples)
  cobra_estimates <- cobra(design, dat)
  rownames(cobra_estimates$Q) <- paste0(sp,"_",rownames(dat))
  colnames(cobra_estimates$Q) <- colnames(dat)
  Sigma_D<-t(cobra_estimates$Q)#Unlike the publication, we do not need to extract any batch specific effect. Our objective is to obtain a network of the entire transition, not stage specific ones. So we use the decomposed matrix as is.
  datExp<-t(dat)
  hclust(dist(datExp), method = "average")->clust
    return(list(dge_keep=dge_keep, pcaDat=pcaDat, plot=plot_pca, clust=clust, wgcna_in=Sigma_D))
}

## Define soft threshold
soft_threshold <- function(data) {
  library(WGCNA)
  allowWGCNAThreads(nThreads=10)
  # Choose a set of soft-thresholding powers, given a WGCNA data object
  powers = c(seq(from = 5, to=20, by=1))
  # Call the network topology analysis function
  sft = pickSoftThreshold(data, powerVector = powers, verbose = 5,RsquaredCut = 0.80,moreNetworkConcepts = T,networkType = "signed")
  # Plot the results:
  sizeGrWindow(9, 5)
  par(mfrow = c(1,2));
  cex1 = 0.9;
  # Scale-free topology fit index as a function of the soft-thresholding power
  plot(sft$fitIndices[,1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3])*sft$fitIndices[,2],
       xlab="Soft Threshold (power)",ylab="Scale Free Topology Model Fit,signed R^2",type="n",
       main = paste("Scale independence"));
  text(sft$fitIndices[,1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3])*sft$fitIndices[,2],
       labels=powers,cex=cex1,col="red");
  # this line corresponds to using an R^2 cut-off of h
  abline(h=0.80,col="red")
  # Mean connectivity as a function of the soft-thresholding power
  plot(sft$fitIndices[,1], sft$fitIndices[,5],
       xlab="Soft Threshold (power)",ylab="Mean Connectivity", type="n",
       main = paste("Mean connectivity"))
  text(sft$fitIndices[,1], sft$fitIndices[,5], labels=powers, cex=cex1,col="red")
  par(mfrow = c(1,1));
  
  return(sft)
}


## define adjacency function
wgcna_adjacency <- function(datExpr, minModuleSize=50, MEDissThres = 0.25, deepSplit = 2, power) {
  library(flashClust)
  library(WGCNA)
  # takes WGNCA data expression matrix, a soft threshold
  # optionally minimum module size, module eigengene dissimilarity threshold, and splitting threthold
  # returns adjacency matrix, module eigengenes and a data frame of colors
  enableWGCNAThreads()

  #compute adjacency
  adjacency <- adjacency(datExpr, power = power,type="signed")
  TOM <- TOMsimilarity(adjacency,TOMType="signed")
  # Calculate TOM-based connectivity
  geneTree <- flashClust::flashClust (as.dist(1-TOM), method = "average")

  # Module identification using dynamic tree cut
  dynamicMods <- dynamicTreeCut::cutreeDynamic(dendro = geneTree, distM = 1-TOM, deepSplit = 2, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE, minClusterSize = 50,);
  table(dynamicMods)
  dynamicColors = labels2colors(dynamicMods)

  # Calculate eigengenes
  MEList = moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = dynamicColors)
  MEs = MEList$eigengenes
  # Calculate dissimilarity of module eigengenes
  METree = flashClust(as.dist(1-cor(MEs)), method = "average");
  plot(METree, main = "Clustering of module eigengenes",xlab = "", sub = "")
  abline(h=MEDissThres, col = "red")
  merge <- mergeCloseModules(datExpr, dynamicColors, cutHeight = MEDissThres, verbose = 0)

  # The merged module colors
  mergedColors = merge$colors
  # Eigengenes of the new merged modules:
  mergedMEs = merge$newMEs

  # Rename to moduleColors
  moduleColors = mergedColors
  # Construct numerical labels corresponding to the colors
  colorOrder = c("grey", standardColors(50));
  moduleLabels = match(moduleColors, colorOrder)-1;
  MEs = mergedMEs;

  # Recalculate MEs with color labels
  invisible(MEs0 <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr, moduleColors)$eigengenes)

  print(table(moduleColors))
  moduleColors <- as.data.frame(moduleColors)
  rownames(moduleColors) <- colnames(datExpr)
  
  # Calculate TOM-based connectivity
  MEs = orderMEs(MEs0)
  TOMConnectivity <- rowSums(TOM)
  
  # Module-specific TOM connectivity
  moduleTOMConnectivity<-function(mod){
  tibble(gene=moduleColors %>% filter(moduleColors == mod) %>% rownames(), 
         degree=TOMConnectivity[which(moduleColors == mod)],
         module = mod) %>% return()
}

purrr::map(unique(moduleColors$moduleColors),moduleTOMConnectivity) %>% purrr::list_rbind()->connectivity


  return(list(adjacency=adjacency,MEs=MEs,moduleColors=moduleColors, dynamicMods=dynamicMods, connectivity=connectivity, METree=METree, geneTree=geneTree))
}

#Module heatmaps
module_heatmaps<-function(dat,net,cols,corr_ref_plot){

  colnames(dat$counts)<-dat$samples$group
#heat_dat<-dat$counts %>% reshape2::melt() %>% 
heat_dat<-cpm(dat$counts, log = T,prior.count = 1e-5,normalized.lib.sizes = T) %>% reshape2::melt() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(genes = Var1,stages = Var2, logCPM = value) %>% 
  summarise(mean_logCPM = mean(logCPM),.by = c(genes,stages)) %>% group_by(genes) %>% 
  mutate(z.score = (mean_logCPM - mean(mean_logCPM))/sd(mean_logCPM)) %>% ungroup()
heat_dat %>% summary()->sum
#clip the data at the 95 quantile to aid in visualisation
heat_dat<-heat_dat %>% mutate(z.clipped = case_when(
  z.score > quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95) ~ quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95),
  z.score < -quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95) ~ -quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95),
  T ~ z.score
))
qnt<-quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95) #used for plotting
make_heat_dat<-function(mod){
  heat_dat %>% filter(genes %in% (net$connectivity %>% filter(module == mod) %>% pull(gene))) %>% 
    summarise(mod.z = mean(z.clipped),.by = stages) %>% 
    mutate(mod = mod) %>% return()
  }

heat_plot_dat<-purrr::map(unique(net$connectivity$module),make_heat_dat) %>% list_rbind()
#Order the modules
wide<-heat_plot_dat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = stages,values_from = mod.z) 
wide<-wide %>% mutate(diff=wide[[length(wide)]]-wide[[2]])
wide<-wide %>% mutate(phase = case_when(
    diff < quantile(wide$diff, 0.33) ~ "early",
    diff > quantile(wide$diff, 0.33) & diff < quantile(wide$diff, 0.66) ~ "mid",
    diff >= quantile(wide$diff, 0.33) ~ "late"
)) %>% arrange(factor(phase, levels=c("early","mid","late")))

heat_plot_dat<-full_join(wide,heat_plot_dat, by = "mod") %>% arrange(diff) %>% dplyr::select(mod,stages,mod.z,phase)
#plot
heat<-ggplot(data = heat_plot_dat,aes(x = stages,y = as.factor(mod)))+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(factor(phase, levels = c("early","mid","late"))),
                         scales = "free")+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = mod.z), color = "grey80",) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = (cols(11)), limits = c(-qnt, qnt),
                       breaks = c(-qnt, 0, qnt), labels = c(paste0("<", round(-qnt)), "0", paste0(">", round(qnt))))+
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 90))+
  ylab("Modules")+
  theme_minimal()
  return(list(heat=heat, sum=sum, dat=heat_plot_dat))
}

#Module lineplots
module_pres_lineplots<-function(dat,mp_net,orth_exp,plot_mods){
  colnames(dat$counts)<-dat$samples$group
  heat_dat<-dat$counts %>% reshape2::melt() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(orths = Var1,stages = Var2, logCPM = value) %>% 
  summarise(mean_logCPM = mean(logCPM),.by = c(orths,stages)) %>% group_by(orths) %>% 
  mutate(z.score = (mean_logCPM - mean(mean_logCPM))/sd(mean_logCPM)) %>% ungroup() 
  
  heat_dat<-heat_dat %>% mutate(z.clipped = case_when(
  z.score > quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95) ~ quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95),
  z.score < -quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95) ~ -quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95),
  T ~ z.score
))
  heat_dat<-left_join(heat_dat,orth_exp) %>% drop_na() %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(contains("Sample"),sp))
#heat_dat<-heat_dat %>% dplyr::select(-c(contains("Sample"),sp))
  
  make_line_plot<-function(mod){
    plot_dat<-heat_dat %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (mp_net$connectivity %>% filter(module == mod)
                                                   %>% pull(gene)))
    qnt<-quantile(plot_dat$z.score,0.95) #used for plotting
    # Define where to place the vertical panel (on the right side)
    x_rect_start <- length(levels(plot_dat$stages))+ .1
    x_rect_end <- length(levels(plot_dat$stages))+ 1  # Adjust width of the rectangle as needed
    rec_fill = mod
    lp<-ggplot(plot_dat,aes(x = stages, y = z.clipped,group = orths))+
      geom_line(alpha = 0.3, color = "grey70")+ 
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-qnt, qnt)) +
      geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_rect_start, 
                    xmax = x_rect_end, 
                    ymin = -Inf, 
                    ymax = Inf), 
                fill = mod, alpha = 0.2,color = "white") +  # Add vertical rectangle on the right
      geom_line(data = (plot_dat %>% summarise(mean_exp = mean(z.score),.by = "stages")),
                aes(x = stages, y = mean_exp, group = 1),linewidth = 1, color = "grey30")+
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.title = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
    return(lp)
  }
  colors<-as.list(plot_mods$mods)
  purrr::map(colors,make_line_plot)->line_plots
  
  return(line_plots %>% patchwork::wrap_plots(ncol = 5))
}

#Orth network stats table
make_orth_table<-function(.x){
  orthdata<-read_tsv("./04.Orthogroups/Results_Oct15/Orthogroups/Orthogroups.tsv") #ouput from OrthoFinder
  orthdata %>% dplyr::select(c(Orthogroup,contains(.x))) %>% drop_na()->d
  ncols<-max(stringr::str_count(d[,2],",")) +1
  colmn<-paste("col",1:ncols)
  d %>% separate(col = 2,sep = ",",into = colmn,remove = T)->d
  d %>% pivot_longer(!Orthogroup)->d
  d %>% mutate(orths = str_remove(d$value," ")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Orthogroup,orths) %>%
    drop_na() %>% mutate(sp = .x) %>% return()
}

#Module preservation heatmaps
module_heatmaps_pres_analysis<-function(dat,net,cols){
heat_dat<-dat %>% reshape2::melt() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(genes = Orthogroup,stages = variable, logCPM = value) %>% 
  summarise(mean_logCPM = mean(logCPM),.by = c(orths,genes,module,stages)) %>% group_by(genes) %>% 
  mutate(z.score = (mean_logCPM - mean(mean_logCPM))/sd(mean_logCPM)) %>% ungroup()
heat_dat %>% summary()->sum
#clip the data at the 95 quantile to aid in visualisation
heat_dat<-heat_dat %>% mutate(z.clipped = case_when(
  z.score > quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95) ~ quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95),
  z.score < -quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95) ~ -quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95),
  T ~ z.score
))
qnt<-quantile(heat_dat$z.score,0.95) #used for plotting
make_heat_dat<-function(mod){
  #When running on module pres data change the orths in the filter to genes
  heat_dat %>% filter(genes %in% (net$connectivity %>% filter(module == mod) %>% pull(gene))) %>% 
    summarise(mod.z = mean(z.clipped),.by = stages) %>% 
    mutate(mod = mod) %>% return()
}

heat_plot_dat<-purrr::map(unique(net$connectivity$module),make_heat_dat) %>% list_rbind()
heat_plot_dat<-heat_plot_dat %>% mutate(stages=as.character(stages), mod=as.character(mod), mod.z=as.numeric(mod.z)) %>% distinct(stages,mod.z,mod)

#Order the modules
wide<-heat_plot_dat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = stages,values_from = mod.z) 
heat_plot_dat<-full_join(heat_plot_dat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = stages,values_from = mod.z) %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(diff = list(wide[[ncol(wide)]]-wide[[2]]
)) %>% arrange(diff) %>% 
  dplyr::select(mod),heat_plot_dat,by = c("mod"))
heat_plot_dat<-heat_plot_dat %>% mutate(mod = factor(mod,levels = unique(mod)))

heat<-ggplot(data = heat_plot_dat,aes(x = stages,y = as.factor(mod)))+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = mod.z), color = "grey80",) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = (cols(11)), limits = c(-qnt, qnt),
                       breaks = c(-qnt, 0, qnt), labels = c(paste0("<", round(-qnt)), "0", paste0(">", round(qnt))))+
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 90))+
  theme_minimal()
return(list(plot=heat, dat=heat_plot_dat, sum=sum))
}

#Module preservations and expression plots
make_tiles_and_mp_plot<-function(d,cols){
  plot_dat<-d %>% mutate(pres = case_when(
    z.score <=6  ~ "no preservation",
    z.score > 6 & z.score <= 12 ~ "low to medium preservation",
    z.score > 12 ~ "high preservation")) %>% drop_na()
  plot_dat$mods<-fct_reorder(plot_dat$mods, plot_dat$rank)
  qnt<-quantile(plot_dat$mod.z,0.95)
  p<-ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = mods, y = stages)) +
    facet_grid(.~ pres, scales = "free", space = "free") +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = mod.z),color="white") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = (cols(11)), limits = c(-qnt, qnt+0.3),
                         breaks = c(-qnt, 0, qnt),
                         labels = c(paste0("<", round(-qnt)), "0", paste0(">",round(qnt))))+
    geom_tile(aes(color = pres),alpha=0.1,size=1)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#497BB6", "#B6497B", "#7BB649"))+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
  return(list(plot=p, dat=plot_dat))
}

#Summaries of orth network
check_orth_exp_sumarries<-function(a,b,exp_dat){
  exp_dat %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% c(a,b)) %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T)->raw_dat

  exp_dat %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% c(a,b)) %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% 
  reframe(across(starts_with("Sample"), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),.by = ("Orthogroup"))->og_mean
  
  exp_dat %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% c(a,b)) %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% 
  reframe(across(starts_with("Sample"), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)),.by = ("Orthogroup"))->og_sum
  
  exp_dat %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% c(a,b)) %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% 
  reframe(across(starts_with("Sample"), \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)),.by = ("Orthogroup"))->og_median
  
  exp_dat %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% c(a,b)) %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% 
  filter(orths %in% (exp_dat %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% c(a,b)) %>% 
           distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% rowwise(orths) %>%

                       slice_min(m,by = "Orthogroup") %>% pull(orths)))->og_min
  
  raw_dat$orths<-fct_reorder(raw_dat$orths, raw_dat$Orthogroup)
  
  p1<-ggplot(raw_dat %>% pivot_longer(cols = contains("Sample")) %>%

#Orthologous networks
make_orth_net_input<-function(d){
  
  dge <- DGEList(d,group = colnames(d),genes = rownames(d))
  dge<-calcNormFactors(dge,method = "TMM")
  dge_keep<-dge
  dat <- cpm(dge, log = T,prior.count = 1e-5,normalized.lib.sizes = T)
  design <- model.matrix(~1+group, dge$samples)
  cobra_estimates <- cobra(design, dat)
  rownames(cobra_estimates$Q) <- rownames(dat)
  colnames(cobra_estimates$Q) <- colnames(dat)
  Sigma_D<-t(cobra_estimates$Q)#Unlike the publication, we do not need to extract any batch specific effect. Our objective is to obtain a network of the entire transition, not stage specific ones. So we use decomposed matrix as is.
  datExp<-t(dat)
  hclust(dist(datExp), method = "average")->clust
  return(list(dge_keep=dge_keep, wgcna_in=Sigma_D, clust=clust))
}

#Module preservation plots
module_pres_plots<-function(mp,heatdat,cols,c1,c2){
mp<-mp
modPreservStats = mp$preservation$Z #Extract module preservation statistics
Z_summary = modPreservStats[[c1]][[c2]]$Zsummary.pres #Summarize the Z-summary for all modules
print(Z_summary)
d<-tibble(mods = rownames(modPreservStats[[c1]][[c2]]), 
                     z.score = modPreservStats[[c1]][[c2]]$Zsummary.pres,
                     rank=mp$preservation$observed[[c1]][[c2]]$medianRank.pres) %>% arrange(rank)
d$mods<-factor(d$mods,levels = d$mods)
left_join(heatdat %>% dplyr::rename(mods=mod),d,by = "mods") %>% arrange(rank) ->plot_dat
make_tiles_and_mp_plot(d = plot_dat,cols)->p

return(p)
}

#Jaccard index and Fishers exact test
get_jaccard_estimate<-function(col1,col2,net1,net2){
  jac<-function(net1,net2,col1,col2) {
    #Get the indices of the genes in each of the modules
    g1<-which((net1 %>% rownames_to_column("g") %>% arrange(g))$moduleColors==col1)
    g2<-which((net2 %>% rownames_to_column("g") %>% arrange(g))$moduleColors==col2)
    # Jaccard index
    #checks the similarity in terms of whether the same genes are present in the same module(irrespective of colour of the modules).
    #Basically checks if genes tend to co-occur together.
    jaccard_index <- length(intersect(g1, g2)) / length(union(g1, g2))
    
    #Fisher's exact test to see of there are more significant overlaps
    uni<-length(clown_orth_net$moduleColors$moduleColors) #all orthologous networks have the same length
    overlap_matrix <- matrix(c(length(intersect(g1, g2)), length(setdiff(g1, g2)),
                               length(setdiff(g2, g1)), uni - length(union(g1, g2))), 
                             nrow = 2)
    fisher.test(overlap_matrix,alternative = "greater")->res
    data.frame(jaccard_index=jaccard_index, c1=col1, c2=col2, f.test.pval=res$p.value) %>% return()
  }
  jac(net1 = net1, net2 = net2, col1 = col1, col2 = col2) -> d
  return(d)
}

#Getting homologous modules
 homo_mods<-function(c1,c2,c3,c4,c5){
  #Combing all the GO annotations into a single df and filter out the terms that are present in at least 4 species.
   #Please not that these are not specific annotations of the modules, but rather generalisations.
   rbind(clown_orth_mods_proc[[c1]][[1]],
         grouper_orth_mods_proc[[c2]][[1]],
         manini_orth_mods_proc[[c3]][[1]],
         goby_orth_mods_proc[[c4]][[1]],
         danio_orth_mods_proc[[c5]][[1]]) %>% 
     summarise(n=n(), .by = "GOBPID") %>% filter(n>=4) %>% 
     pull(GOBPID)->common_GOs

   
   #Use the common GO terms to filter out annotations and filter the FDR sig ones and pick the top 10 sig
   #These top 10 terms should largely be relevant across modules since we picked common terms in at least 4 species
   rbind(clown_orth_mods_proc[[c1]][[1]] %>% mutate(sp="clown"),
         grouper_orth_mods_proc[[c2]][[1]] %>% mutate(sp="grouper"),
         manini_orth_mods_proc[[c3]][[1]] %>% mutate(sp="manini"),
         goby_orth_mods_proc[[c4]][[1]] %>% mutate(sp="goby"),
         danio_orth_mods_proc[[c5]][[1]] %>% mutate(sp="danio")) %>% filter(GOBPID %in% common_GOs) %>% 
     filter(FDR < 0.05) %>% mutate(col.clown=c1) %>% arrange(FDR) %>% head(30) %>% return()
 }

correlation_test <- function(x, y) {
  test <- cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman")
  tibble(
    corr = test$estimate,
    p_value_adj = p.adjust(test$p.value,method = "BH",)
  ) 
}

#Make the expression matrix data frame
no_of_tissue_samples_in_each_fish<-function(x){
  bgee_dat %>% dplyr::filter(Anatomical.entity.name == x) %>% dplyr::group_by(Species) %>% dplyr::summarise(Libraries = length(unique(Library.ID)))
}
make_exp_data_frames<-function(.data, ...){
  .data %>% filter(Library.ID %in% bgee_dat$Library.ID) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Gene.ID, TPM, Library.ID, Detection.flag) %>% 
    filter(Detection.flag == "present") %>% dplyr::select(-c(Detection.flag)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = Library.ID,values_from = TPM) %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0)
}

#Processing Bgee data
Bgee_dge<-function(.data){
  library(edgeR)

  design_matrix<-.data %>% filter(Library.ID %in% bgee_dat$Library.ID) %>% 
                 dplyr::select(Experiment.ID,Library.ID,Anatomical.entity.name) %>% distinct()
  
  dge<-edgeR::DGEList(.data %>% make_exp_data_frames() %>% column_to_rownames("Gene.ID"), group = factor(design_matrix$Anatomical.entity.name))
    return(dge$counts %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(Gene.ID=rownames(dge$counts)))
    
}

#Building the tau data frame 
build_exp_data_frame<-function(.data, sp) {
  left_join(.data %>% pivot_longer(!Gene.ID,names_to = "Library.ID",values_to = "tpm"),
            bgee_dat %>% filter(Species == sp) %>% 
              dplyr::select(Library.ID,Anatomical.entity.name),by = "Library.ID") %>% 
    group_by(Gene.ID,Anatomical.entity.name) %>% 
    summarise(tpm = mean(tpm)) %>% 
    spread(Anatomical.entity.name,tpm) %>% ungroup() %>% return()
}


copy_num_heatmap_plot<-function(gene_list, module, tree){  
  #Make wide and fill in the absent orthogroups with 0
  orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (gene_list %>% filter(mod==module) %>% pull(genes))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% pivot_longer(-sp) %>% 
    dplyr::rename("Orthogroup"="name", "no_of_gene_copies"="value")->heat_dat

  
  heat_dat<-heat_dat %>% filter(sp %in% tree$tip.label)
  #recalibrate
  heat_dat %>% 
  mutate(
    cn_group = case_when(
      no_of_gene_copies == 0~"0",
      no_of_gene_copies == 1~"1",
      no_of_gene_copies == 2~"2",
      no_of_gene_copies == 3~"3",
      no_of_gene_copies == 4~"4",
      no_of_gene_copies == 5~"5",
      no_of_gene_copies  > 5~">5"),
    cn_group = factor(cn_group, levels = c(as.character(0:5), ">5"))) %>% 
    mutate(sp = factor(sp, levels = tree$tip.label)) %>% 
    mutate(Orthogroup=reorder(Orthogroup,-no_of_gene_copies))->heat_dat
  
  col<-colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "grey50","grey10"))
  
  green_palette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "YlGnBu")[3:8])(5)
  highlight   <- "#D55E00"  #orange for >5
  fill_values <- c("white",green_palette, highlight)# this is for 0, 1-5, and >5 gene copies
  names(fill_values) <- levels(heat_dat$cn_group)
  
  heat_dat %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y=sp,x=Orthogroup, fill=cn_group))+
    geom_tile()+
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values,drop=FALSE,            # ensures all levels appear even if absent
                      name   = "Copy Number")+
    labs(subtitle = paste0(module))+
    scale_y_discrete(labels = ~ gsub("_", " ", .x))+
    theme_linedraw()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")) %>% return()
  }

#COMPLETE PHYLOGENETIC ANALYSIS
complete_phylogenetic_analysis<-function(gene_list,module){
  gl=gene_list
  m=module
  
  compute_gene_copy_phylosig<-function(gl,m){
    orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (gl %>% filter(mod==m) %>% pull(genes))) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
      replace(is.na(.), 0)->sp_genes_wide
  #log transform count data with pseudocount to stabilize variance and reduce skew
    log2((sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))+1e-5) %>% rownames_to_column("species")->species_trait
    colnames(species_trait)[2:length(colnames(species_trait))]->genes.colnames
    
    get_phylo_sig<-function(names_of_gene){
      sp_trait<-setNames(species_trait[[paste(names_of_gene)]],sp_genes_wide$sp)
      #geiger::name.check(pruned_tree, sp_trait)
      Pag_lam_sig<-phylosig(pruned_tree,sp_trait , method="lambda", test=TRUE, nsim=1000)
      tree_lam<-phytools::rescale(pruned_tree, model="lambda", Pag_lam_sig$lambda)
      Blom_K_sig<-phylosig(tree_lam,sp_trait , method="K", test=TRUE, nsim=1000)
      
      tibble(Orthogroup=names_of_gene,
             pag_lam_sig=Pag_lam_sig$lambda,
             pag_pval=Pag_lam_sig$P,
             blom_K_sig=Blom_K_sig$K,
             blom_K_pval=Blom_K_sig$P) %>% return()
      }
    
    purrr::map(genes.colnames, get_phylo_sig) %>% list_rbind() %>% 
      filter(pag_pval < 0.05 & blom_K_pval < 0.05) %>% return()
    }
  compute_gene_copy_phylosig(gl,m)->orth_mod_physig

#Remove the species with extra WGD
  left_join(taxa %>% filter(!Family %in% c("Cyprinidae","Cobitidae","Catostomidae","Salmonidae")), 
            tibble(sp=pruned_tree$tip.label),by = "sp")->tips_to_keep
  
  do_phylo_anova<-function()
    #prune tree
    drop.tip(pruned_tree,pruned_tree$tip.label[-match(tips_to_keep$sp, pruned_tree$tip.label)])->no_WGD_tree
#get focal tips
#focal_tips <-c(extract.clade(no_WGD_tree, c(221))$tip.label,
#               extract.clade(no_WGD_tree, c(220))$tip.label,
#               extract.clade(no_WGD_tree, c(217))$tip.label,
#               extract.clade(no_WGD_tree, c(207))$tip.label)

#141: Acanthomorpha
#189: Syngnathiformes
  focal_tips <-c(extract.clade(no_WGD_tree, c(141))$tip.label)

#make trait vector
  orth_gene_copy %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% orth_mod_physig$Orthogroup) %>% 
    filter(sp %in% no_WGD_tree$tip.label) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(Family, Order, SpecCode)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = Orthogroup, values_from = no_of_gene_copies) %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0)->sp_genes_wide
#log transform count data with pseudocount to stabilize variance and reduce skew
  log2((sp_genes_wide %>% column_to_rownames("sp"))+1e-5) %>% rownames_to_column("species")->species_trait
  colnames(species_trait)[2:length(colnames(species_trait))]->genes.colnames

#phy anova step
  run_anova_for_genes<-function(names_of_gene){
  #ensure same order as tree
    sp_trait<-setNames(species_trait[[paste0(names_of_gene)]],species_trait$species)
    traits_vec <- sp_trait[no_WGD_tree$tip.label]
    #Specify the grouping variables
    grouping <- factor(ifelse(names(traits_vec) %in% focal_tips,
                              "focal", "background"))
  
  #Run the phy anova
  set.seed(42)
  #ignore the warning, the order is the same as tree
  phylanova_res <- phylANOVA(no_WGD_tree, grouping, traits_vec, nsim = 1000, p.adj = "BH") 
  #The perfect fit warning is when there is no change in copy number
  #i.e. no unexplained variance in the data based on the model
  
  tibble(Orthogroup=names_of_gene,
         F_val=phylanova_res$F,
         p_val_adj=phylanova_res$Pf) %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% return()
  }
  
  purrr::map(genes.colnames, run_anova_for_genes) %>% list_rbind() %>% mutate(module=module) %>% return()
}

#possibly modification to bypass any formatting error
complete_phylogenetic_analysis_possibly<-purrr::possibly(complete_phylogenetic_analysis,otherwise = NULL)


validation_lines<-function(dat1,dat2,fill1,fill2,types){
  d.clown<-dat1$dge_keep$counts %>% 
    cpm(log = T,prior.count = 1e-5,normalized.lib.sizes = T)  %>% 
    reshape2::melt() %>% 
    dplyr::rename(orths = Var1,stages = Var2, logCPM = value) %>% 
    filter(orths %in% dat2$Orthogroup) %>% group_by(orths) %>% 
    mutate(z.score = (logCPM - mean(logCPM))/sd(logCPM)) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
  d.clown<-d.clown %>% mutate(z.clipped = case_when(
    z.score > quantile(d.clown$z.score,0.95) ~ quantile(d.clown$z.score,0.95),
    z.score < -quantile(d.clown$z.score,0.95) ~ -quantile(d.clown$z.score,0.95),
    T ~ z.score)) %>% mutate(sp="clown")

d.clown %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=stages, y=z.score, group=orths))+
  facet_wrap(vars(orths), nrow =5)+
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, color="grey10", fill=fill1)+
  geom_line(data = (d.clown %>% filter(sp=="clown")
                    %>% summarise(mean_exp = mean(z.score),.by = c("stages","orths"))),
            aes(x = stages, y = mean_exp, group = 1),linewidth = 1, color = fill2)+
  ylim(-2.2,2.2)+
  ylab("Z-score")+
  labs(subtitle =paste0(types))+
  theme_light()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.1)) %>% return()
}

#CAFE processing functions
cafe_trait_tree<-function(tree, change_dat, model, prune=FALSE, with_tips=FALSE){
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggnewscale)
  
    concat_trees<-function(trees_in,name,tips,prune){
      tree<-trees_in
     
      
      #This is used to get the gene copy number at the root
      (str_split(tree$node.label[1],"_",simplify = TRUE))[,2] %>% 
        as.numeric()->root_node_copy
      
      #Prune the tree to only include species with trait data when option set to TRUE
      pruned_tree.model <- if (isTRUE(prune)) {
        drop.tip(
          tree,
          tree$tip.label[-match(
            tips,
            str_split(tree$tip.label, "</*", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
          )]
        )
      } else {
        tree
      }
      
      
      #intialise the tree
      ggtree::ggtree(pruned_tree.model,layout="rectangular")->g
      gene_copy_levels <- c("0","1","2","3","4","5",">5")#Copy number variable
      
      #Change the CAFE naming format
      g$data %>%
        tidyr::extract(
          label, into = c("species", "angle_tag", "suffix"),
          regex = "^([^<]*)(<\\d+>)(?:\\*)?(_\\d+)$", remove = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(species=na_if(species, ""),
               gene_copy=dplyr::case_when(
                 stringr::str_detect(label, "<135>") ~ root_node_copy,
                 TRUE ~ readr::parse_number(suffix)),
               #collapse to seven display levels
               gene_copy_disp = case_when(
                 is.na(gene_copy) ~ NA_character_,
                 gene_copy > 5    ~ ">5",
                 TRUE ~ as.character(gene_copy)),
               gene_copy_disp = factor(gene_copy_disp, 
                                       levels = gene_copy_levels),
               isSig = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(label, "\\*"), "yes", "no")) %>% 
        mutate(join_col=paste0(species,angle_tag) %>% str_remove_all("NA")) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(suffix, angle_tag)) %>% 
        mutate(genes=paste0(name))->g$data
      g$data %>% return()

} 

    model$data$sp->include.tips.model
  
purrr::imap(.x= tree,
            ~concat_trees(trees_in = .x, name = .y, 
                               tips = include.tips.model,
                          prune = prune)) %>% 
   list_rbind()-> tree_data_list
 

change_dat %>% pivot_longer(-FamilyID,names_to = "node", values_to = "change") %>% 
  mutate(genes = str_remove_all(FamilyID, "OG")) %>% 
  filter(genes %in% cafe_genefamily_outs$genes) %>% mutate(
    sign = case_when(
      change >  0 ~ "expansion",
      change < 0 ~ "contraction",
      TRUE          ~ "remains"
    )) %>%
  dplyr::count(node, sign, genes) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = sign,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0) %>% 
  mutate(type_of_change=case_when(
    expansion > 0 ~ "expansion", 
    contraction > 0 ~ "contraction", 
    .default = "remains"))->exp_cont_dat

ggtree::ggtree(tree_data_list,layout="rectangular")->g

  left_join(tree_data_list,exp_cont_dat %>%
            dplyr::select(node, genes, type_of_change) %>% 
              mutate(genes=paste0("OG",exp_cont_dat$genes)) %>% 
              dplyr::rename("join_col"="node"),
          by=c("genes","join_col"), relationship = "many-to-many")->g$data


#define  palette 
fill_values_cp <- c(
  "0"  = "grey",
  "1"  = "#A4BFA8",
  "2"  = "#2A8C5E",
  "3"  = "#F2CB05",
  "4"  = "#735702",
  "5"  = "#F25252",   
  ">5" = "#F25252"
  )

  g <- if (isTRUE(with_tips)) {
    g + geom_tiplab(aes(label=str_replace_all(species,pattern = "_",replacement = " ")),
                as_ylab = FALSE,offset = 5, size=2, align = TRUE, fontface="italic")+ hexpand(.7)
    } else {
    g
  }
  
  g+
    facet_wrap(~genes)+
    geom_tree(aes(color=type_of_change), show.legend=TRUE)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#5430D9","#D90467","grey"))+
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color()+
    geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, 
                 fill=gene_copy_disp,
                 color=isSig,
                 stroke=ifelse(isSig == "yes", 0.5, 0),
                 size   = ifelse(isSig == "yes", 2, 1.5)),
             shape=21)+
  scale_size_identity()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=fill_values_cp)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("white","black")) %>% return()

}

cafe_get_age_of_change<-function(tree, change_dat, cafe_genefamily_res){
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggnewscale)
  
   trees <- if (inherits(tree, "phylo")) list(tree) else tree
  if (is.null(names(trees))) names(trees) <- paste0("OG", seq_along(trees))
  
  concat_trees<-function(trees_in,name){
    tr<-trees_in
    
    
    #This is used to get the gene copy number at the root
    (str_split(tr$node.label[1],"_",simplify = TRUE))[,2] %>% 
      as.numeric()->root_node_copy
    
    
    #intialise the tree
    ggtree::ggtree(tr,layout="rectangular")->g
    gene_copy_levels <- c("0","1","2","3","4","5",">5")#Copy number variable
    
    #Change the CAFE naming format
    g$data %>%
      tidyr::extract(
        label, into = c("species", "angle_tag", "suffix"),
        regex = "^([^<]*)(<\\d+>)(?:\\*)?(_\\d+)$", remove = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(species=na_if(species, ""),
             gene_copy=dplyr::case_when(
               stringr::str_detect(label, "<135>") ~ root_node_copy,
               TRUE ~ readr::parse_number(suffix)),
             #collapse to seven display levels
             gene_copy_disp = case_when(
               is.na(gene_copy) ~ NA_character_,
               gene_copy > 5    ~ ">5",
               TRUE ~ as.character(gene_copy)),
             gene_copy_disp = factor(gene_copy_disp, 
                                     levels = gene_copy_levels),
             isSig = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(label, "\\*"), "yes", "no")) %>% 
      mutate(join_col=paste0(species,angle_tag) %>% str_remove_all("NA")) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-c(suffix, angle_tag)) %>% 
      mutate(genes=paste0(name))->g$data
    g$data %>% return()
    
  } 
  
  purrr::imap(.x= trees,
              ~concat_trees(trees_in = .x, name = .y)) %>% 
    list_rbind()-> tree_data_list
  
  
  change_dat %>% pivot_longer(-FamilyID,names_to = "node", values_to = "change") %>% 
    mutate(genes = str_remove_all(FamilyID, "OG")) %>% 
    filter(genes %in% cafe_genefamily_res$genes) %>% mutate(
      sign = case_when(
        change >  0 ~ "expansion",
        change < 0 ~ "contraction",
        TRUE          ~ "remains"
      )) %>%
    dplyr::count(node, sign, genes) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = sign,
      values_from = n,
      values_fill = 0) %>% 
    mutate(type_of_change=case_when(
      expansion > 0 ~ "expansion", 
      contraction > 0 ~ "contraction", 
      .default = "remains"))->exp_cont_dat
  
  ggtree::ggtree(tree_data_list,layout="rectangular")->g
  
  left_join(tree_data_list,exp_cont_dat %>%
              dplyr::select(node, genes, type_of_change) %>% 
              mutate(genes=paste0("OG",exp_cont_dat$genes)) %>% 
              dplyr::rename("join_col"="node"),
            by=c("genes","join_col"), relationship = "many-to-many")->g$data
  
  g$data %>% return()
  
 
}

phylo_pca_plot<-function(pp, traitlabel){
  
  #pp<-model_brain$pink
  eig  <- pp$pca_gene_pca$Eval
  load <- pp$pca_gene_pca$Evec
  scores <- pp$pca_gene_pca$S
  trait_dat <- pp$model_brms_brain$data
  
  # ensure names for PCs
  pc_names <- paste0("PC", seq_along(eig))
  colnames(load)   <- colnames(load)   %||% pc_names
  colnames(scores) <- colnames(scores) %||% pc_names
  
  var_exp<-eig/sum(eig) * 100  # % variance explained
  
  scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores) %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("species") %>% 
    dplyr::select(species, PC1, PC2)
  
  load_df <- as.data.frame(load) %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>% 
    dplyr::select(gene, PC1, PC2)
  
  # Scale eigenvector arrows to fit on the same axes as scores (simple, effective)
  s_range <- max(diff(range(scores_df$PC1)), diff(range(scores_df$PC2)))
  l_range <- max(diff(range(load_df$PC1)),   diff(range(load_df$PC2)))
  arrow_scale <- 0.7 * s_range / l_range
  arrow_df <- load_df %>% 
    mutate(PC1 = PC1 * arrow_scale,
           PC2 = PC2 * arrow_scale)
  
 scores_df<-left_join(trait_dat %>% dplyr::select(2,3), scores_df,by = c("sp"="species"))
  ## 1) Species scores (PC1 vs PC2) -------------------------------------------
 scores_df %>% mutate(sp=str_replace_all(sp,pattern = "_",replacement = " ")) %>% 
   ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, fill=BrainWeight)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8, shape=21,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.8, height = 0.8, seed = 1)) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = sp), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf,fontface = "italic") +
   scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "G",direction = -1, name = paste0(traitlabel))+
   geom_segment(inherit.aes = FALSE,
     data = arrow_df,
     aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
     arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.02, "npc")),
     linewidth = 0.4,alpha=0.5)+
   geom_text_repel(inherit.aes = FALSE,data = arrow_df,
                   aes(PC1, PC2, label = gene),
                   size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, 
                   color="red",alpha=0.8)+
   labs(x=paste0("phyPC1 (",var_exp[1,1] %>% round(1),"%)"),
        y=paste0("phyPC2 (",var_exp[2,2] %>% round(1),"%)"))+
    theme_linedraw()+theme(legend.position = "top") %>% return()
}
#Functions to make plots of brms model fit
shapes_brms_plot<-function(model_list){

map_dfr(
  model_list,
  ~ summary(.x$fit, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))$summary %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("model_vars"),
  .id = "model_id"
) %>%
  filter(str_detect(model_vars, "\\.cpy")) %>% 
  mutate(feature=str_split(model_vars, pattern = "_",simplify = T)[,2],
         eigengene=str_split(model_vars, pattern = "_",simplify = T)[,3]) %>%
  mutate(feature=reorder(feature,`95%`))->model_plot_dat

model_plot_dat %>%
  mutate(
    # order features if you prefer a specific order
    feature    = factor(feature, levels = c("PC1trait","PC2trait")),
    eigengene  = factor(eigengene),
    model_id   = factor(model_id),
    sig95      = (`5%` > 0 & `95%` > 0 | `5%` < 0 & `95%` < 0)   # CI excludes 0
  )->plot_dat

  left_join(plot_dat,module_annot,by = c("model_id"="mod"))->plot_dat
  ggplot(plot_dat, aes(y = mean, x = feature, group = eigengene, fill = sig95)) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(annot), cols = vars(eigengene), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color="red") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = `5%`, ymax = `95%`),
                   width = 0.15, 
                   alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig95, color=sig95), size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#6B9650","#E674EA"))+
    labs(x = "Model estimate",
         y = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(panel.spacing = unit(5, "pt"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
          strip.text.x.top =  element_text(angle = 0, size = 8),
          strip.text.y.right =  element_text(angle = 360, size = 6,hjust = -0.01),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0,
                                     size = 8))  %>% 
  return()
}

```

### Getting the data

Load the data gene expression data from Kallisto output and make a list object with various components.

```{r}
#Grouper
expression_matrix_and_pca(sp = "Grouper",colramp = colorRampPalette(c("#4d3f2c","#aa9576","#D9AD22","#D9C343")))->grouper
#Manini
expression_matrix_and_pca(sp = "Manini",colramp = colorRampPalette(c("grey40","grey","#f7f2a9","#9acd32")))->manini
#Goby
expression_matrix_and_pca(sp = "Goby",colramp = colorRampPalette(c("#45BA99","#5E45BA","#BA4566","#A1BA45")))->goby
#Clown
expression_matrix_and_pca_clown()->clown
#Danio
expression_matrix_and_pca_danio()->danio

```

### Soft thresholds

This step estimates the power to acheive the scale free topology of the data. Choosing a soft threshold power for the developmental time-series data is not straight forward due to the dynamic nature of the gene expression. Therefore, I chose a power that balances the scale free nature of the data and it's mean connectivity to ensure that I don't get too sparse networks. I pick the highest power that has a mean connectivity of greater than 100.

```{r,eval=F}
#Grouper
soft_threshold(grouper$wgcna_in)->sft_grouper#pick 14
#Manini
soft_threshold(manini$wgcna_in)->sft_manini #pick 13
#Goby
soft_threshold(goby$wgcna_in)->sft_goby #pick 10
#Clownfish
soft_threshold(clown$wgcna_in)->sft_clown#pick 11
#Danio
soft_threshold(danio$wgcna_in)->sft_danio#pick 11
```

### Making the networks

This step constructs the network.

```{r,eval=FALSE}
#Grouper
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = grouper$wgcna_in, power = 14)->grouper_net
grouper_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/grouper_net.rds")

#Manini
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = manini$wgcna_in, power = 13)->manini_net
manini_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/manini_net.rds")

#Goby
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = goby$wgcna_in, power = 10)->goby_net
goby_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/goby_net.rds")

#Clown
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = clown$wgcna_in, power = 11)->clown_net
clown_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/clown_net.rds")

#Danio
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = danio$wgcna_in, power = 11)->danio_net
danio_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/danio_net.rds")

```

## Load networks

```{r}
grouper_net<-readRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/grouper_net.rds")
manini_net<-readRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/manini_net.rds")
goby_net<-readRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/goby_net.rds")
clown_net<-readRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/clown_net.rds")
danio_net<-readRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/danio_net_pruned.rds")
```

### Module heatmaps

Here I make heatmaps to check the expression of the co-expression modules across development. I segregate the modules into three groups with higher expression in the early, mid, and late stages of development.

```{r}
module_heatmaps(dat=grouper$dge_keep,
                net=grouper_net,
                cols=colorRampPalette(c("#25151b", "white", "#D9C343")))->grouper_heatmap

module_heatmaps(dat=manini$dge_keep,
               net=manini_net,
               cols = colorRampPalette(c("#25151b", "white","#9acd32")))->manini_heatmap

module_heatmaps(dat = goby$dge_keep,
                net = goby_net,
                cols = colorRampPalette(c("#25151b","white","#BA4566")))->goby_heatmap

module_heatmaps(dat=clown$dge_keep,
                net=clown_net,
                cols = cols.clown)->clown_heatmap

module_heatmaps(dat=danio$dge_keep,
                net=danio_net,
                cols = cols.danio)->danio_heatmap
```

```{r}
get_GOterms<-function(mod){
  #genes<-net$moduleColors %>% filter(moduleColors == "mod") %>% rownames_to_column("g") %>% mutate(g1 = paste0(sp,"_",g))
  #universe<-annot %>% filter(str_detect(genes,sp)) %>% distinct(genes) #%>% pull(gene)

  #genes<-orth %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% green_mod) %>% filter(str_detect(orths,"ENS")) %>% pull(orths)
  
  params_up<-GSEAGOHyperGParams(name = "GO enrich", 
                             geneSetCollection = gsc,
                             geneIds = genes,
                             universeGeneIds = universe,
                             ontology = "BP",
                             pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                             conditional = F,
                             testDirection = "over")
  
  Over_up<- hyperGTest(params_up)
  Over_up.pv<-pvalues(Over_up)
  pv.fdr<-p.adjust(Over_up.pv,"fdr")
  summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(FDR = pv.fdr[1:nrow(summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble())]) %>%
    dplyr::select(GOBPID,FDR,Term,Count,Size) %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) -> GOenrich_up #Set the cut-off high just to see what possible processes the genes within modules are involved in
  
  return(GOenrich_up)
}

                             ontology = "BP",
                             pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                             conditional = F,

  Over_up.pv<-pvalues(Over_up)
  pv.fdr<-p.adjust(Over_up.pv,"fdr")
  summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(FDR = pv.fdr[1:nrow(summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble())]) %>%
    dplyr::select(GOBPID,FDR,Term,Count,Size) %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) -> GOenrich_up #Set the cut-off high just to see what possible processes the genes within modules are involved in
  
  return(GOenrich_up)
}

get_GOterms_homomods<-function(cat,module,gene_set){
  universe<-annot %>% filter(genes %in% metamorph_orthlist$orths)
  gene_list<-gene_set %>% filter(mod==module) %>% pull(genes)
  genes<-metamorph_orthlist %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% gene_list) %>% pull(orths)
  
  
  params_up<-GSEAGOHyperGParams(name = "GO enrich", 
                             geneSetCollection = gsc,
                             geneIds = genes,
                             universeGeneIds = universe,
                             ontology = cat,
                             pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                             conditional = F,
                             testDirection = "over")
  
  Over_up<- hyperGTest(params_up)
  Over_up.pv<-pvalues(Over_up)
  pv.fdr<-p.adjust(Over_up.pv,"fdr")
  summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(FDR = pv.fdr[1:nrow(summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble())]) %>%
    dplyr::select(paste0("GO",cat,"ID"),FDR,Term,Count,Size) %>% filter(FDR<0.05) -> GOenrich_up #Set the cut-off high just to see what possible processes the genes within modules are involved in
  GOenrich_up %>% mutate(mod=module)->GOenrich_up
  
  return(GOenrich_up)
}
```

## Getting ortholog expression matrix

Since the goal of this project is to identify core sets of genes mediating metamophorosis across different species of fish I need to estimate the orthologs between the genes and construct networks of the orthologous genes. For that I need to construct an ortholog gene expression matrix. I estimate orthlogs from OrthoFinder and filter out only the genes families that are present in all 5 species. This step ensures we select gene families that have a common evolutionary history, and not ones that have species-specific evolutionary trajectories (either gains or losses).

```{r}
orth<-readRDS("./04.Orthogroups/Orthologer_latest.rds") 

rbind(
rbind(
  orth %>% filter(str_detect(orths,"ENSAOCG")),
  orth %>% filter(str_detect(orths,"ENSDARG"))) %>% 
  mutate(orths= str_remove(orths,"\\.[0-9]*")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Orthogroup,orths,sp),
rbind(
    orth %>% filter(str_detect(orths,"Goby")),
    orth %>% filter(str_detect(orths,"Grouper")),
    orth %>% filter(str_detect(orths,"Manini")))  %>%
  dplyr::select(Orthogroup,orths,sp))->metamorph_orthlist

full_orths<-metamorph_orthlist %>% summarise(n = n(),.by = c(Orthogroup,sp)) %>% summarise(n = n(),.by = c(Orthogroup)) %>% filter(n == 5)

#Get clown orths
left_join(clown$dge_keep$counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("orths"),
          metamorph_orthlist %>% filter(str_detect(orths, "ENSAOCG"))) %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% full_orths$Orthogroup) %>% drop_na() %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T)->clown_orth_exp

#Get grouper orths
left_join(grouper$dge_keep$counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("orths"),
          metamorph_orthlist %>% filter(str_detect(orths, "Grouper"))) %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% full_orths$Orthogroup) %>% drop_na()->grouper_orth_exp

#Get manini orths
left_join(manini$dge_keep$counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("orths"),
          metamorph_orthlist %>% filter(str_detect(orths, "Manini"))) %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% full_orths$Orthogroup) %>% drop_na()->manini_orth_exp

#Get goby orths
left_join(goby$dge_keep$counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("orths"),
          metamorph_orthlist %>% filter(str_detect(orths, "Goby"))) %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% full_orths$Orthogroup) %>% drop_na()->goby_orth_exp

#Get danio orths
left_join(danio$dge_keep$counts %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("orths"),
          metamorph_orthlist %>% filter(str_detect(orths, "ENSDARG"))) %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% full_orths$Orthogroup) %>% drop_na()->danio_orth_exp

```

Since there are typically multiple gene copies we decided to use the copy with the highest expression for each orthogroup. Our objective is not to check how individual gene copies are co-expressed (at lease not yet), but rather get insight into the general co-expression of genes with similar functions. In this regard, choosing the gene copy with the highest expression will generally capture the most predominant signal and expression trends. The following piece of code shows that there is almost no difference in general expression trends when representing ortholog expression by using summary measure like mean, median, or summed expression and when selecting the ortholog with the highest expression.

```{r}
#Randomly picks genes with multiple copies and displays summary metrics; users can try other fish and change the higher range of the runif
check_orth_exp_sumarries(exp_dat = clown_orth_exp,
                         a = (clown_orth_exp %>% janitor::get_dupes(Orthogroup) %>% distinct(Orthogroup))[runif(n = 1,min = 1,max =1835),1],
                         b = (clown_orth_exp %>% janitor::get_dupes(Orthogroup) %>% distinct(Orthogroup))[runif(n = 1,min = 1,max =1835),1])
```

### Making ortholog expression matrix

In this step I process the gene expression matrices to obtain a one-to-one (not single copy) orthogroup expression matrix. The expression matrices for each species contain the same orthogroups, hence are symetrical. They only vary by expression value and developmental stage.

```{r}
#Making ortholog matix
#Clown
clown_orth_exp %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% rowwise(orths) %>% 
           mutate(m=mean(Sample1:Sample21)) %>% ungroup() %>%  
           slice_max(m,by = "Orthogroup") %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% 
  distinct(Orthogroup,.keep_all = T)->clown_orth_exp
cln<-clown_orth_exp %>% dplyr::select(-c(orths,Orthogroup,sp,m)) %>% as.matrix()
colnames(cln)<-paste0(clown$dge_keep$samples$group, rep(".clown",length(clown$dge_keep$samples$group)))
clown_orth_exp_mat<-cbind(orths.clown = clown_orth_exp$orths, Orthogroup = clown_orth_exp$Orthogroup,
                      cln %>% as.data.frame())
#Grouper

  distinct(Orthogroup,.keep_all = T)->grouper_orth_exp
grp<-grouper_orth_exp %>% dplyr::select(-c(orths,Orthogroup,sp,m)) %>% as.matrix()
colnames(grp)<-paste0(grouper$dge_keep$samples$group, rep(".grouper",length(grouper$dge_keep$samples$group)))
grouper_orth_exp_mat<-cbind(orths.grouper = grouper_orth_exp$orths, Orthogroup = grouper_orth_exp$Orthogroup,
                      grp %>% as.data.frame())
#Manini
manini_orth_exp %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% rowwise(orths) %>% 
           mutate(m=mean(Sample1:Sample19)) %>% ungroup() %>%

  distinct(Orthogroup,.keep_all = T)->manini_orth_exp
mnn<-manini_orth_exp %>% dplyr::select(-c(orths,Orthogroup,sp,m)) %>% as.matrix()

           mutate(m=mean(Sample1:Sample24)) %>% ungroup() %>%  
           slice_max(m,by = "Orthogroup") %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% 
  distinct(Orthogroup,.keep_all = T)->goby_orth_exp
gbb<-goby_orth_exp %>% dplyr::select(-c(orths,Orthogroup,sp,m)) %>% as.matrix()
colnames(gbb)<-paste0(goby$dge_keep$samples$group, rep(".goby",length(goby$dge_keep$samples$group)))
goby_orth_exp_mat<-cbind(orths.goby = goby_orth_exp$orths, Orthogroup = goby_orth_exp$Orthogroup,
                      gbb %>% as.data.frame())

#Danio
danio_orth_exp %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% rowwise(orths) %>% 
           mutate(m=mean(Sample1:Sample20)) %>% ungroup() %>%  
           slice_max(m,by = "Orthogroup") %>% distinct(orths,.keep_all = T) %>% 
  distinct(Orthogroup,.keep_all = T)->danio_orth_exp
dnr<-danio_orth_exp %>% dplyr::select(-c(orths,Orthogroup,sp,m)) %>% as.matrix()

#Use join to avoid non-unique column name and the filter from the above data frames.
purrr::reduce(list(goby_orth_exp_mat %>% dplyr::select(c(Orthogroup,orths.goby)),

make_orth_net_input(d = clown_all_orth_exp_mat %>% column_to_rownames("Orthogroup"))->clown_orth_net_in
```

## Orthologus networks

### Soft threshold

This step estimates the power to achieve the scale free topology of the data. Choosing a soft threshold power for the developmental time-series data is not straight forward due to the dynamic nature of the gene expression. Therefore, I chose a power that balances the scale free nature of the data and it's mean connectivity to ensure that I don't get too sparse networks. I pick the power that has a scale-free R2 of at least 0.7. While this is not the most idea, since I am going to compare modules downstream to identify homologous modules, I can check for function information from the modules.

```{r,eval=FALSE}
soft_threshold(clown_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_clown_orth_net#pick 13 
soft_threshold(grouper_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_grouper_orth_net #pick 13
soft_threshold(goby_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_goby_orth_net #pick 12
soft_threshold(manini_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_manini_orth_net #pick 13
soft_threshold(danio_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_danio_orth_net #pick 13

rbind(sft_clown_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="clown"),
      sft_grouper_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="grouper"),
      sft_goby_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="goby"),
      sft_manini_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="manini"),
      sft_danio_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="danio")) %>% dplyr::select(sp,Power,SFT.R.sq,mean.k.,median.k.,max.k.,Density) %>% filter(SFT.R.sq>0.8 & median.k.>10) %>% view()
```

### Making the networks

This step constructs the network.

```{r,eval=FALSE}
#Clown
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = clown_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 13)->clown_orth_net

#Grouper
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = grouper_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 13)->grouper_orth_net

#Goby
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = goby_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 12)->goby_orth_net

#Manini
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = manini_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 13)->manini_orth_net

#Danio
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = danio_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 13)->danio_orth_net

clown_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/clown_orth_net.rds")
grouper_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/grouper_orth_net.rds")
goby_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/goby_orth_net.rds")
manini_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/manini_orth_net.rds")
danio_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/danio_orth_net.rds")
```

### Network stats

We see that the networks have almost the same number of modules. This is expected since the gene expression matrix has same number of orthogroups and the soft thresholds were similar. There is slight variation in the average module size and mean connectivity with zebrafish having the lowest average module size, while clownfish modules have the lowest average connectivity.

```{r}
tibble(Species=c("Clonwfish","Grouper","Goby","Manini","Zebrafish"),
       Number_of_modules=c(length(clown_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),
                           length(grouper_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),
                           length(goby_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),
                           length(manini_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),
                           length(danio_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module))),
       
       Median_module_size=c(clown_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% median(),
                             grouper_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% median(),
                             goby_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% median(),
                             manini_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% median(),
                             danio_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% median()),
       
       Mean_mod_size=c(clown_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% mean() %>% round(),
                             grouper_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% mean() %>% round(),
                             goby_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% mean() %>% round(),
                             manini_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% mean() %>% round(),
                             danio_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% mean()) %>% round(),
       
       Mean_connectivity=c(mean(clown_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3),
                           mean(grouper_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3),
                           mean(goby_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3),
                           mean(manini_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3),
                           mean(danio_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3))) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl() %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), 
                            full_width = F, 
                            position = "left")

```

### Orth module heatmaps

Here I make heatmaps to check the expression of the co-expression modules across development. I segregate the modules into three groups with higher expression in the early, mid, and late stages of development.

```{r}

module_heatmaps(dat=clown_orth_net_in$dge_keep,
                net=clown_orth_net,
                cols=cols.clown)->clown_orth_heatmap

module_heatmaps(dat=grouper_orth_net_in$dge_keep,
                net=grouper_orth_net,
                cols=cols.grouper)->grouper_orth_heatmap

module_heatmaps(dat=manini_orth_net_in$dge_keep,
               net=manini_orth_net,
               cols=cols.manini)->manini_orth_heatmap

module_heatmaps(dat=goby_orth_net_in$dge_keep,
                net=goby_orth_net,
                cols=cols.goby)->goby_orth_heatmap

module_heatmaps(dat=danio_orth_net_in$dge_keep,
                net=danio_orth_net,
                cols=cols.danio)->danio_orth_heatmap
```

```{r}
three_system_col_plots<-function(orth_net, col){

  orth_net$connectivity %>% dplyr::select(gene,module) %>% 
  filter(gene %in% full_vision_orths$Orthogroup) %>% 
  mutate(sys="vision system") %>% dplyr::count(sys, module) %>% 
  mutate(per_of_gene_set=(n/sum(n))*100) %>% 
  rbind(
    orth_net$connectivity %>% dplyr::select(gene,module) %>% 
      filter(gene %in% full_thyroid_orths$Orthogroup) %>% 
      mutate(sys="thyroid hormone regulation") %>% dplyr::count(sys, module) %>% 
      mutate(per_of_gene_set=(n/sum(n))*100)
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
    orth_net$connectivity %>% dplyr::select(gene,module) %>% 
      filter(gene %in% full_lipid_orths$Orthogroup) %>% 
      mutate(sys="lipid metabolism") %>% dplyr::count(sys, module) %>% 
      mutate(per_of_gene_set=(n/sum(n))*100)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(coexp=case_when(n >= 2 ~"yes", .default = "no")) %>% 
  mutate(module=reorder(module, -per_of_gene_set)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y=per_of_gene_set, x=module, fill=coexp))+
  facet_wrap(~sys, scales="free", nrow=3)+
  geom_col(color="black", linewidth=0.2, alpha=0.9)+
  geom_text(aes(y=per_of_gene_set-1, label = paste0(round(per_of_gene_set,1),"%")), 
            size=2, color="grey95")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#25151b",col), name="contains multiple\n system genes")+
  labs(y="Percentage of gene set")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90,size=8,hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"))
}


co_occurence_sig_test<-function(orth_net,sys1,sys2){
  
  #co-occurence dataset for system genes that are expressed in the same module
  co_occur_df<-orth_net$connectivity %>% dplyr::select(gene,module) %>% 
    mutate(co_mod=case_when(gene %in% sys1$Orthogroup | 
      gene %in% sys2$Orthogroup ~ "co-occur", 
      .default = "co-occur_not"))
  
  #make an additional random gene set for sanity check
  co_occur_df_random<-orth_net$connectivity %>% dplyr::select(gene,module) %>% 
    mutate(co_mod=case_when(
      gene %in% sample(orth_net$connectivity$gene,length(sys1$Orthogroup)) | 
        gene %in% sample(orth_net$connectivity$gene,length(sys2$Orthogroup)) ~ "co-occur", 
      .default = "co-occur_not"))
  
  #test the target gene sets
  tibble(target_set_pval=
           (fisher.test(table(co_occur_df$module, co_occur_df$co_mod), 
                        simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 5000, alternative = "greater"))$p.value,
         random_set_pval= 
           (fisher.test(table(co_occur_df_random$module, co_occur_df_random$co_mod), 
                        simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 5000, alternative = "greater"))$p.value
) %>% return()

}

rbind(
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = clown_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="clownfish", sys="thyroid~vision"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = manini_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="manini", sys="thyroid~vision"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = goby_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="goby", sys="thyroid~vision"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = grouper_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="grouper", sys="thyroid~vision"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = danio_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="zebrafish", sys="thyroid~vision")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = clown_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="clownfish", sys="thyroid~lipid"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = manini_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="manini", sys="thyroid~lipid"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = goby_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="goby", sys="thyroid~lipid"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = grouper_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="grouper", sys="thyroid~lipid"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = danio_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="zebrafish", sys="thyroid~lipid")
  )->co_occurence_tests
```

#### STRING comparison

Overall we observe that a 48% (16/33) of our modules significantly capture known interactions between genes, highlighting the ability of the networks to capture biological signals.

```{r, eval=F}
#Load the data
danio_orth_net<-readRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/danio_orth_net.rds")
orth_danio<-orth %>% filter(sp=="Danio_rerio") %>% mutate(orths=str_remove(orths,"\\.[0-9]"))
orth_danio<-orth_danio %>% mutate(Orthogroup=as.character(orth_danio$Orthogroup))
danio_biomart<-read_csv("./Danio_biomart.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Gene stable ID`,`Protein stable ID`,`Gene name`, `Gene description`)
#STRING data
string<-read_csv("./7955.protein.links.v12.0.csv")
string<-string %>% mutate(protein1=str_remove(protein1,"7955."), 
                          protein2=str_remove(protein2,"7955."))
#string<-string %>% filter(combined_score >= quantile(string$combined_score, 0.5)) # can try using a score threshold
danio_orth_mods<-left_join(danio_orth_net$connectivity, orth_danio, by=c("gene"="Orthogroup")) %>% 
  left_join(danio_biomart, by=c("orths"="Gene stable ID")) %>% na.omit()

#Make df with STRING data
ppi_mods<-left_join(string,danio_orth_mods, by = c("protein1" = "Protein stable ID"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::rename(module.X = module) %>% left_join(danio_orth_mods, by = c("protein2" = "Protein stable ID"),relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  na.omit() %>% dplyr::rename(module.Y = module)

#Identify intra-module interactions
intra_module_ppis <- ppi_mods %>%
  filter(module.X == module.Y) 
#Count the number of instances of genes co-occuring in the same module
intra_module_ppis_counts<-intra_module_ppis %>%
  dplyr::count(module.X, name = "Num_Interactions") 

total_interactions_per_module <- ppi_mods %>%
  dplyr::count(module.X, name = "Total_Interactions") 

#ppi_mods %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/ppi_mods_0.5_score.rds")


intra_module_ppis_counts %>%
  left_join(total_interactions_per_module, by = "module.X") %>%
  mutate(Enrichment_Score = Num_Interactions / Total_Interactions)->intra_module_ppis_summary

    dplyr::rename(module.X = Shuffled_Module) %>% left_join(shuffled_df, by = c("protein2" = "Protein_ID"),relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
    na.omit() %>% dplyr::rename(module.Y = Shuffled_Module)
  
  #Get intra_module counts;
  #tells us the number of instances of two genes being in the same module,
  #i.e. how often do they interact
  intra_module_ppis_shuffled <- ppi_shuffled %>%
    filter(module.X == module.Y) %>%
    dplyr::count(module.X, name = "Num_Interactions") 
  
  empirical_P<-mean(ppi_shuffled %>%
                      filter(module.X == module.Y) %>%
                      nrow() > 
                      intra_module_ppis %>%
                      filter(module.X == module.Y) %>%
                      nrow())
  #Calculate the empirical_P per module and them summarise them after running the function. 
  left_join(intra_module_ppis_shuffled,intra_module_ppis_counts, by = "module.X") %>% group_by(module.X) %>% summarise(em_p=mean(Num_Interactions.x > Num_Interactions.y)) %>% ungroup() %>% return()
  }

purrr::map(1:1000,~permute_counts()) %>% list_rbind() %>% group_by(module.X) %>% 
  summarise(empirical_P=mean(em_p)) %>% 
  ungroup()->STRING_perm_test_res

STRING_perm_test_res %>% dplyr::count(empirical_P < 0.05)

STRING_perm_test_res %>% saveRDS("./STRING_perm_test_res.rds")
```

```{r}
STRING_perm_test_res<-readRDS("./STRING_perm_test_res.rds")
STRING_perm_test_res %>% mutate(sig=case_when(empirical_P < 0.05 ~ "Yes",
                                              .default = "No")) %>% mutate(module.X=reorder(module.X, empirical_P)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=1, y=module.X, fill=sig))+
    geom_tile()+geom_text(aes(label=round(empirical_P,2), x=1),color="white",size=3)+
    ggsci::scale_fill_jama(name="Is significant")+
  labs(x="empirical p-value", y="module", subtitle = "STRING comparison test")+
    theme_bw()+
```

### Clownfish and goby

```{r}
#clown:317
#Grouper:310
#Goby:363
#Manini:385
#Zebrafish:385

expand_grid(c1=(clown_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)), 
            c2=(goby_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)))->jac_input

# Run the function with the ability to specify net1 and net2
purrr::map2(.x = jac_input$c1, 
            .y = jac_input$c2,  
            ~ get_jaccard_estimate(.x, .y, 
                                   net1 = clown_orth_net$moduleColors, 
                                   net2 = goby_orth_net$moduleColors)) %>% list_rbind() %>% 
  arrange(desc(jaccard_index))->membership_stats

#Reorder colums and adjust the pvalues
membership_stats %>% mutate(col.goby=reorder(c2,-jaccard_index)) %>% 
  mutate(col.clown=reorder(c1,-jaccard_index)) %>% 
  mutate(padj=p.adjust(membership_stats$f.test.pval,"BH"))->membership_stats

#Join with the heatmap data
full_join(mp_plot_clown_ref_goby$dat %>% dplyr::rename(col.clown=mods),
          membership_stats, by = "col.clown",relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(clown.pres=pres, stages.clown=stages, mod.z.clown=mod.z)->membership_stats
#Join with the heatmap data
full_join(mp_plot_goby_ref_clown$dat %>% dplyr::rename(col.goby=mods),
          membership_stats, by = "col.goby",relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(goby.pres=pres, stages.goby=stages, mod.z.goby=mod.z) ->membership_stats

membership_stats %>% dplyr::select(c(col.clown, col.goby, jaccard_index, padj, clown.pres, goby.pres)) %>% 
  mutate(sig_ovelap=case_when(
  padj < 0.05 ~ "yes", padj > 0.05 ~ "no")) %>% mutate(col.clown=reorder(col.clown,-jaccard_index))->membership_stats2

full_join(membership_stats %>% dplyr::select(c(col.clown, col.goby, jaccard_index, padj, clown.pres, goby.pres)) %>%
             mutate(sig_ovelap=case_when(
               padj < 0.05 ~ "yes", padj > 0.05 ~ "no")) %>% mutate(col.clown=reorder(col.clown,-jaccard_index)),
           membership_stats2 %>% filter(sig_ovelap == "yes") %>% 
             mutate(homo=case_when(
               jaccard_index >= quantile(membership_stats$jaccard_index,0.75) & sig_ovelap == "yes" ~ "homologous",
               .default = "non-homologous")) %>% 
     distinct(col.clown,col.goby, .keep_all = T) %>% 
   slice_max(order_by = jaccard_index,by = col.clown,n = 2,) %>% dplyr::select(col.clown,col.goby,homo),by = c("col.clown","col.goby")) %>%
   replace_na(list(homo="non-homologous"))->membership_stats2
  
membership_stats2 %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x=col.goby, y=col.clown))+
  geom_tile(aes(fill=jaccard_index, color=homo, width=0.8, height=0.8), size=0.3)+
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  facet_grid(clown.pres~goby.pres,space = "free",scales = "free")+
  labs(x=NULL, y=NULL)+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9,"Oranges"),limits=c(0,0.5))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black","white"))+
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color()+
  geom_point(aes(color = sig_ovelap),alpha=0.3,size=0.3,shape=8)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("white","red3"))+
  theme_void()+
  theme(strip.text = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "left",
        axis.text = element_blank())->p1

  
  membership_stats %>% dplyr::select(c(col.clown, col.goby, jaccard_index, padj, clown.pres, goby.pres,phase.x)) %>% mutate(col.clown=reorder(col.clown,-jaccard_index)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=col.goby,y=1))+
    geom_tile(aes(fill=goby.pres))+
    facet_grid(cols = vars(goby.pres),space = "free",scales = "free")+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#497BB6", "#B6497B", "#7BB649"))+
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()+
    geom_tile(aes(fill=phase.x, y=2))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#497", "#B64", "#7BB"))+
    labs(x="Goby modules", y=NULL)+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90,hjust = -0.005,vjust = 0.2),
          strip.text = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")->p2
  
  membership_stats %>% dplyr::select(c(col.clown, col.goby, jaccard_index, padj, clown.pres, goby.pres,phase.y)) %>% mutate(col.clown=reorder(col.clown,-jaccard_index)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y=col.clown,x=1))+
    facet_grid(rows = vars(clown.pres),space = "free",scales = "free")+
    geom_tile(aes(fill=clown.pres))+
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#497BB6", "#B6497B", "#7BB649"))+
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()+
    geom_tile(aes(fill=phase.y, x=0))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#497", "#B64", "#7BB"))+
    labs(x=NULL, y="Clownfish modules")+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(strip.text = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x =  element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")->p3
  
  qnt<-max(membership_stats$mod.z.clown)
  membership_stats %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = stages.clown,y = col.clown))+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(clown.pres),space = "free",scales = "free")+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = mod.z.clown), color = "grey80",) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rev(cols.clown(11)), limits = c(-qnt, qnt),
                       breaks = c(-qnt, 0, qnt), labels = c(paste0("<", round(-qnt)), "0", paste0(">", round(qnt))))+
  labs(y=NULL, x="Clownfish stages")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,hjust = -0.005,vjust = 0.2),
                        strip.text = element_blank(),
                        strip.background = element_blank(),
                        panel.grid = element_blank(),
                        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                        legend.position = "top")->p4
  
  qnt<-max(membership_stats$mod.z.goby)
  membership_stats %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = stages.goby,x = col.goby))+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(goby.pres),space = "free",scales = "free")+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = mod.z.goby), color = "grey80",) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rev(cols.goby(11)), limits = c(-qnt, qnt),
                       breaks = c(-qnt, 0, qnt), labels = c(paste0("<", round(-qnt)), "0", paste0(">", round(qnt))))+
  labs(x=NULL, y="Goby stages")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(strip.text = element_blank(),
                        strip.background = element_blank(),
                        panel.grid = element_blank(),
                        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                        legend.position = "bottom")->p5
  
  
  
wrap_plots(p1,p3,p2,nrow = 2,ncol = 2, heights = c(1,0.05), widths = c(1, 0.05))->wrapped_plot_clown_goby
```

```{r}
   replace_na(list(homo="non-homologous"))->membership_stats2

          strip.text = element_blank(),
```

```{r}
expand_grid(c1=(manini_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),

purrr::map2(.x = jac_input$c1, 
            .y = jac_input$c2,

                                   net1 = manini_orth_net$moduleColors,

  arrange(desc(jaccard_index))->membership_stats

#Reorder colums and adjust the pvalues
membership_stats %>% mutate(col.goby=reorder(c2,-jaccard_index)) %>% 
  mutate(col.manini=reorder(c1,-jaccard_index)) %>% 
  mutate(padj=p.adjust(membership_stats$f.test.pval,"BH"))->membership_stats

#Join with the heatmap data
full_join(mp_plot_manini_ref_goby$dat %>% dplyr::rename(col.manini=mods),
          membership_stats, by = "col.manini",relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(manini.pres=pres, stages.manini=stages, mod.z.manini=mod.z)->membership_stats

             mutate(sig_ovelap=case_when(
               padj < 0.05 ~ "yes", padj > 0.05 ~ "no")) %>% mutate(col.manini=reorder(col.manini,-jaccard_index)),
           membership_stats2 %>% filter(sig_ovelap == "yes") %>% 
             mutate(homo=case_when(
               jaccard_index >= quantile(membership_stats$jaccard_index,0.75) & sig_ovelap == "yes" ~ "homologous",
               .default = "non-homologous")) %>% 
     distinct(col.manini,col.goby, .keep_all = T) %>%

   replace_na(list(homo="non-homologous"))->membership_stats2
```

```{r}
        axis.text = element_blank())->p1


  membership_stats %>% dplyr::select(c(col.goby, col.danio, jaccard_index, padj, goby.pres, danio.pres,phase.x))  %>% mutate(col.goby=reorder(col.goby,-jaccard_index)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=col.danio,y=1))+
    facet_grid(cols = vars(danio.pres),space = "free",scales = "free")+
    geom_tile(aes(fill=danio.pres))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#497BB6", "#B6497B", "#7BB649"))+
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()+
    geom_tile(aes(fill=phase.x, y=2))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#497", "#B64", "#7BB"))+
    labs(x="danio modules", y=NULL)+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90,hjust = -0.005,vjust = 0.2),
          strip.text = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")->p2
  
  
  
  membership_stats %>% dplyr::select(c(col.goby, col.danio, jaccard_index, padj, goby.pres, danio.pres,phase.y)) %>% mutate(col.goby=reorder(col.goby,-jaccard_index)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(y=col.goby,x=1))+
    facet_grid(rows = vars(goby.pres),space = "free",scales = "free")+
    geom_tile(aes(fill=goby.pres))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#497BB6", "#B6497B", "#7BB649"))+
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill()+
    geom_tile(aes(fill=phase.y, x=0))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#497", "#B64", "#7BB"))+
    labs(x=NULL, y="goby modules")+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(strip.text = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x =  element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")->p3
  
  qnt<-max(membership_stats$mod.z.goby)
  membership_stats %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = stages.goby,y = col.goby))+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(goby.pres),space = "free",scales = "free")+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = mod.z.goby), color = "grey80",) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rev(cols.goby(11)), limits = c(-qnt, qnt),
                       breaks = c(-qnt, 0, qnt), labels = c(paste0("<", round(-qnt)), "0", paste0(">", round(qnt))))+
  labs(y=NULL, x="goby stages")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,hjust = -0.005,vjust = 0.2),
                        strip.text = element_blank(),
                        strip.background = element_blank(),
                        panel.grid = element_blank(),
                        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                        legend.position = "top")->p4
  
  qnt<-max(membership_stats$mod.z.danio)
  membership_stats %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = stages.danio,x = col.danio))+
  facet_grid(cols = vars(danio.pres),space = "free",scales = "free")+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = mod.z.danio), color = "grey80",) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rev(cols.danio(11)), limits = c(-qnt, qnt),
                       breaks = c(-qnt, 0, qnt), labels = c(paste0("<", round(-qnt)), "0", paste0(">", round(qnt))))+
  labs(x=NULL, y="danio stages")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(strip.text = element_blank(),
                        strip.background = element_blank(),
                        panel.grid = element_blank(),
                        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                        legend.position = "bottom")->p5
  
  
  
wrap_plots(p1,p3,p2,nrow = 2,ncol = 2, heights = c(1,0.05), widths = c(1, 0.05))->wrapped_plot_goby_danio
```

### Extract homologous modules

Start in sequence with the largest pairs first.
